subject.title: fix(acp): keep completed run-mode sessions resumable

question: Does OpenClaw want to treat the persisted ACP initialize capability and acpxSessionId-first lookup as the stable upgrade contract for resuming completed run-mode sessions across supported ACP adapters?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but choosing and persisting the canonical cross-process resume identity affects existing session metadata, adapter upgrades, and fail-closed behavior; tests cannot establish that long-term product contract without ACP-owner intent.

options.title: Confirm and land after refresh
options.body: Confirm the capability and ID contract, rebase onto current main, require green focused and upgrade validation, then merge the existing design.

options.title: Narrow the persisted contract
options.body: Keep this PR open while moving adapter-specific resume-ID selection or capability refresh into the ACPX owner boundary with explicit version-aware coverage.

options.title: Pause resumable run mode
options.body: Do not retain completed one-shot metadata until a stable cross-adapter identity and cleanup contract can be guaranteed.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land after refresh
recommendation.body: Confirm the capability and ID contract, rebase onto current main, require green focused and upgrade validation, then merge the existing design.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership documentation explicitly connects this person to ACP integrations, which is the contract being decided.
